lastCompletedStory.title: Isolate the two builder-less signal-bearing supervisor test files (events, ensure-worker-pane)

nextStoryContext:
US-005 (CAM-420) applied the audit F-03 alternative (a) configPath-fixture idiom to the last 2 signal-bearing supervisor test files that had NO opts builder: test/supervisor/events.test.ts (5 runSupervisor call sites, all fully-inline RunSupervisorOptions literals) and test/supervisor/ensure-worker-pane.test.ts (3 runSupervisor call sites, same shape). Each file got its own module-level GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH fixture (own mkdtempSync dir, `[backend]
implementer = "claude"
` project.toml, afterAll cleanup) mirroring the US-003/US-004 idiom, but since neither file has an `overrides`/`Partial<RunSupervisorOptions>` builder to hang a shared default off, the fixture is threaded as a literal `configPath: GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH` sibling key appended directly onto every inline opts object literal at its runSupervisor call site (8 one-line additions total) rather than inventing a builder refactor, exactly as this story's AC1 prescribed. Neither file has any chdir-based test, so there was no opt-out case (no `configPath: undefined` sibling was ever needed in either file). The AC1 oracle is a derived-comparand check, not a frozen count: `grep -c 'configPath: GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH' <file>` == `grep -c 'runSupervisor(' <file>` for each file (5==5 events.test.ts, 3==3 ensure-worker-pane.test.ts), so it stays falsifiable against future call sites added without the fixture line. Verification: `bun test` on those 2 files individually is 26 pass / 0 fail; full `bun test` is 5633 pass / 0 fail (unchanged count from US-004 -- no tests added/removed, only fixture wiring); `bun run typecheck` clean; `bun run check:all` fully green after raising both files' file-size-budget.json ceilings to their gate-measured content.split('
').length counts (events.test.ts 542->562, ensure-worker-pane.test.ts 354->368; note this measure is 1 line more than `wc -l` for each file due to the trailing-newline discrepancy documented in a prior _ref entry) with a dated _ref note naming this story and CAM-420, staged in the same commit. Dress rehearsal (AC2, exact US-003/US-004 recipe: `git worktree add` of committed HEAD, `project.toml`'s [backend] patched to add `implementer = "codex"` as a sibling key under the existing `name = "claude"` -- never replacing it, since the per-phase key wins per readPhaseBackend's precedence -- `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, `bun test` with an emptied HOME): dropped from the documented 6 residual fails (post-US-004 baseline, all in events.test.ts and ensure-worker-pane.test.ts) to EXACTLY 0 fails (5633 pass / 0 fail), completing the full implementer-side isolation arc for CAM-420: 85 fails (US-003 baseline) -> 11 (post-US-003) -> 6 (post-US-004) -> 0 (post-US-005). This PRD's implementer-side scope is now fully isolated from the live scripts/cam/project.toml backend setting; no further follow-up story is implied by this arc. Any future story that adds a NEW runSupervisor call site to either events.test.ts or ensure-worker-pane.test.ts must add the matching `configPath: GENERIC_SUPERVISOR_CONFIG_PATH` sibling key (or an explicit `configPath: undefined` opt-out if it deliberately needs real cwd-relative resolution against its own chdir'd fixture) to keep the AC1-style derived oracle true.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-fixture DI-isolation story, mirroring US-003/US-004 of this same PRD exactly: no new external library surface introduced. RunSupervisorOptions.configPath already existed (US-001 of this PRD) and was already wired into readPhaseBackend/resolvePhaseModel; this story only threaded the pre-existing seam into the last 2 builder-less test files' inline opts literals.
